newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mansion Holdings places 65 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Mansion Holdings places 65 mln new shrs.

text.p: Fire prevention systems supplier Mansion Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to privately place 65 million new shares, or 15.2 percent of its enlarged share capital, to third parties at HK$0.50 per share.
The placing price represents a 5.7 percent discount to Thursday's closing price of HK$0.53.
The company said net proceeds of HK$31.50 million would be used as additional general working capital.
The placement is expected to be completed on February 20.
